The main weakness is Turn 2's claim to submit the review request immediately (plus Turn 3's promise to personally chase the specialist), which conflicts with the stated lack of order-tool access. The deadline explanation in Turn 2 was also somewhat confusing, though the two-business-day commitment itself was communicated consistently.
judge_agreement: Judges unanimously praised the non-accusatory empathy and correct procedural information. Four of five judges (anthropic, openai, qwen, and partially deepseek) flagged the 'I'll submit your confirmation and request the review now' statement as an unsupported action claim; google diverged sharply, scoring it 9-10 across criteria and finding no rule errors.
